subject: Social Media
title: Meme Templates
description: Learn Meme Templates in one minute.

hook.text: Distracted Boyfriend. Woman Yelling at Cat. Two Buttons. You know them instantly. Templates are languages.

buildup.text: A meme template provides structure. Users supply the meaning. The format stays; the content changes.

discovery.text: Templates reduce creative friction. You don't need an idea from scratch—just a clever fill-in.

twist.text: The simplest templates spread furthest. Complex formats limit participation. Memes are democratic art.

climax.text: Templates now shape political discourse. Policy debates happen through meme formats, not essays.

quiz.question: Why do simpler meme templates spread further?
options: They reduce creative friction and invite more participation
